scope: Phase 1 inventory, source interpretation, packet diagnostics, label policy and partition proposal
remaining_before_supervised_extraction: Normalize packet/connection joins conservatively using verified precision and source identity; do not promote the diagnostic +/-1 second search interval to ground truth
Resolve or exclude coarse-time collisions, opposite-direction label conflicts and unmatched records

Determine usable continuous endpoint windows with unknown silence, fragments, unsupported protocols and malformed records excluded as required
Freeze an evaluation design consistent with one source group or independently audit additional source groups
unrecoverable_or_unsupplied_source_facts: original sniffer interface and drop metadata
globally documented GT rounding and inclusive-end semantics
